gap_register.summary: Product ontology adapter lacks canonical output_kind and full event_specificity review axes.
Product source/provenance model does not preserve canonical reviewer, normalization verification, mapping-review, identity-rationale, unresolved-note, and supersession metadata.
A_t/actions exists in ManifestationRoutingContext, but ManifestationMapping/router cannot bind a source-explicit real-world action prerequisite.
Product mapping contract has no explicit execution_readiness, execution_blockers, forbidden_inferences, or negative-boundary fields.
No governed translation exists from separate source_epistemic + normalization_epistemic axes to Product evidence_tier.
KMM-000001 火铃 quantifier remains unresolved; preserve HOLD instead of forcing a Core decision because Product can safely abstain.

lossiness_rules: A lossy crosswalk must retain the original canonical value and an explicit loss rationale outside production registries.
No UNKNOWN, unresolved semantic, modality term, or forbidden inference may be silently dropped.
往往 must never be converted to numeric probability/frequency.
Scene/context must never be promoted to person-level injury, illness, accident, diagnosis, treatment, or medical event.

adapter_feasibility.explanation: The first checkpoint can be audited and partially represented, but the current Product v0.1 ontology/mapping contracts are not lossless enough for canonical promotion. The correct next engineering move is bounded Product schema/crosswalk refinement after P1 acceptance, not a Core rewrite.

p2_handoff.trigger: Core accepts a materially larger canonical manifestation checkpoint.
